cases.prompt: Expand a well-scoped technical topic with a coverage matrix, equations, and an ordered bibliography over multiple passes.
assertions: Preserve original scope and cover all requested subtopics or document gaps.
Attach grounded citations and order the bibliography consistently.
Define equation symbols and record actual validation status.
Stop after two documented complete passes with no material improvement.
cases.grader: Audit source provenance, coverage matrix, equation syntax, iteration log, and bibliography ordering against the produced artifact.

cases.prompt: A requested authoritative citation, /ITQE renderer, or source document is unavailable.
assertions: Do not invent references, DOIs, equations, or executed tools.
Label missing evidence or rendering as BLOCKED or NOT TESTED.
Keep supported portions useful without declaring universal exhaustiveness.
cases.grader: Compare unavailable dependencies with claims and citations; inspect the final limitation report.

cases.prompt: Review a long exposition with duplicated sections, reordered references, and conflicting mathematical definitions.
assertions: Remove substantive duplication and reconcile contradictions.
Verify the accessibility and legibility of any requested visual or document output.
cases.grader: Diff the input and revised artifact, verify citations and formulas, and record observed QA passes.
